status: PROPOSAL -- presentation only, no signal graph implemented
audio: NOT DELIVERED. §19.5 names a low hum, a click on arrival and a rising pitch. None of the three exists and no still or sequence here demonstrates them.

inactive.why: An unbroken hairline at the dim value. A whole conduit with nothing in it. Still, and continuous.

active.why: Full-height lit bar with chevrons pointing the way the signal goes. Scrolls +X at 0.6 m/s. Bright, patterned, moving.

pulse_travelling.why: One short lit block, 12 px (0.375 m), with a solid leading edge, on an otherwise dim line. Scrolls +X at 4.0 m/s. The block's LENGTH never changes -- that is what separates it from a delay.
pulse_travelling.brightness: bright block on a dim line

blocked.why: The same dim line, cut into 6 px segments with 4 px gaps, and one hard break mark across the trough. Dim and SEVERED, against inactive's dim and whole.
blocked.pattern: broken segments plus a break mark

delayed.why: A solid lit FILL from the source end behind a hard leading edge, with the rest of the run dim. The fill GROWS; nothing travels. This frame is the 55% one -- a runtime advances the edge.
delayed.motion: the leading edge advances; the tail never leaves the source
delayed.brightness: bright fill on a dim remainder
delayed.pattern: solid fill behind a hard edge, ticks ahead of it
delayed.audio_required: rising pitch (§19.5) -- THE ONE THAT CARRIES DURATION
